lines.speaker: A
lines.km: សួស្តីបាទ! ខ្ញុំឈ្មោះ ដេវីដ។ ចុះអ្នកវិញ?
lines.rom: Suosdei baat! Knhom chhmous David. Choh neak vinh?
lines.en: Hello! My name is David. And you?

lines.speaker: B
lines.km: ចាស សួស្តី! ខ្ញុំឈ្មោះ បុប្ផា។
lines.rom: Chaa, suosdei! Knhom chhmous Bopha.
lines.en: Hello! My name is Bopha.

lines.speaker: A
lines.km: រីករាយដែលបានស្គាល់អ្នក បុប្ផា។
lines.rom: Rikreay dael baan skoal neak, Bopha.
lines.en: Nice to meet you, Bopha.

lines.speaker: B
lines.km: ចាស រីករាយដូចគ្នា! តើដេវីដមកពីណា?
lines.rom: Chaa, rikreay doch knie! Tae David mok pi na?
lines.en: Nice to meet you too! Where are you from, David?

lines.speaker: A
lines.km: បាទ ខ្ញុំមកពីអាមេរិក។ ចុះបុប្ផាវិញ?
lines.rom: Baat, knhom mok pi Amerika. Choh Bopha vinh?
lines.en: I'm from America. And you, Bopha?

lines.speaker: B
lines.km: ចាស ខ្ញុំជាអ្នកភ្នំពេញនេះឯង។
lines.rom: Chaa, knhom chea neak Phnom Penh nih aeng.
lines.en: I'm from right here in Phnom Penh.

lines.speaker: A
lines.km: សួស្ដីអ្នកមីង ស្វាយនេះមួយគីឡូប៉ុន្មានដែរ?
lines.rom: Suosdei nak-ming, svay nih mouy kilo ponman dae?
lines.en: Hello auntie, how much is this mango per kilo?

lines.speaker: B
lines.km: ចាស មួយគីឡូប្រាំពាន់រៀល ក្មួយ។ ផ្អែមឆ្ងាញ់ណាស់!
lines.rom: Chaa, mouy kilo pram-poan riel kmouy. P'aem chnganh nas!
lines.en: Yes, five thousand riel per kilo, nephew. It's very sweet and tasty!

lines.speaker: A
lines.km: ចុះបើយកពីរគីឡូ ចុះថ្លៃបានបន្តិចទេបាទ?
lines.rom: Choh baeu yok pee kilo, choh thlay ban bontech te baat?
lines.en: If I take two kilos, can you lower the price a little bit?

lines.speaker: B
lines.km: ចាស បាន! គិតតែប្រាំបួនពាន់រៀលបានហើយ។
lines.rom: Chaa, ban! Kit tae pram-buon poan riel ban haeuy.
lines.en: Sure! I'll just charge you nine thousand riel.

lines.speaker: A
lines.km: បាទ អរគុណច្រើន! ខ្ញុំយកពីរគីឡូមក។
lines.rom: Baat, orkun chraeun! Knhom yok pee kilo mok.
lines.en: Thank you very much! I'll take two kilos.

lines.speaker: B
lines.km: ចាស នេះស្វាយក្មួយ អរគុណច្រើនណា!
lines.rom: Chaa, nih svay kmouy, orkun chraeun na!
lines.en: Here are your mangoes, nephew, thank you very much!

lines.speaker: A
lines.km: ពូ ទៅផ្សារថ្មី អស់ប៉ុន្មានដែរ?
lines.rom: Poo, tov Psar Thmey os ponman dae?
lines.en: Uncle, how much to go to Central Market?

lines.speaker: B
lines.km: ទៅផ្សារថ្មី មួយម៉ឺនរៀល ក្មួយ។
lines.rom: Tov Psar Thmey muoy meun riel, kmuoy.
lines.en: To Central Market is ten thousand riel, nephew.

lines.speaker: A
lines.km: ប្រាំបីពាន់បានទេពូ? ខ្ញុំជិះរាល់ដង។
lines.rom: Pram-bei poan ban te poo? Knyom jih roal dorng.
lines.en: Can you do eight thousand, uncle? I ride all the time.

lines.speaker: B
lines.km: អូខេ បាទ! ឡើងមកក្មួយ។
lines.rom: Okay baat! Laeng mok kmuoy.
lines.en: Okay, sure! Hop on, nephew.

lines.speaker: A
lines.km: ពូ ឈប់កន្លែងនេះមក បាទ។
lines.rom: Poo, chop konlaeng nih mok, baat.
lines.en: Uncle, please stop right here.

lines.speaker: B
lines.km: បាទ ដល់ហើយ អរគុណច្រើន!
lines.rom: Baat, dol hoey, orkun chran!
lines.en: Alright, here you are, thanks a lot!

lines.speaker: A
lines.km: សួស្តីបង! សុំបាយឆាសាច់មាន់មួយចាន។
lines.rom: suo sdei bong! som bai chaa sach moan mouy jaan.
lines.en: Hello! Can I have one plate of chicken fried rice, please?

lines.speaker: B
lines.km: ចាសបាន! ចុះចង់ញ៉ាំភេសជ្ជៈអីដែរ?
lines.rom: jaa baan! joh jong nyam pheasa-jeak ey dae?
lines.en: Sure! And what would you like to drink?

lines.speaker: A
lines.km: សុំកាហ្វេទឹកដោះគោទឹកកកមួយដែរ បាទ។
lines.rom: som kaa-feh teuk-doh-ko teuk-kok mouy dae, baat.
lines.en: An iced milk coffee too, please.

lines.speaker: B
lines.km: ចាស រង់ចាំបន្តិចណា៎បង។
lines.rom: jaa, rong-jam bon-tech na bong.
lines.en: Yes, please wait a moment.

lines.speaker: A
lines.km: បង! គិតលុយទាំងអស់ប៉ុន្មានដែរ?
lines.rom: bong! kit luy teang-oh pon-maan dae?
lines.en: Excuse me! How much is everything altogether?

lines.speaker: B
lines.km: ចាស ទាំងអស់បីដុល្លារបង។
lines.rom: jaa, teang-oh bei dollar bong.
lines.en: It is three dollars in total.

lines.speaker: A
lines.km: ជម្រាបសួរអ៊ំ! ខ្ញុំឈ្មោះ ចន បាទ។
lines.rom: chom-reap-suor om! khnhom chmuoh John baat.
lines.en: Hello auntie! My name is John.

lines.speaker: B
lines.km: ចាស ជម្រាបសួរក្មួយ! អញ្ជើញចូលមកលេងក្នុងផ្ទះសិនមក។
lines.rom: jaa, chom-reap-suor kmuoy! anh-chernh jool mok leing knong pteah sin mok.
lines.en: Hello nephew! Please, come inside the house.

lines.speaker: A
lines.km: បាទ អរគុណអ៊ំ។ ខ្ញុំមានផ្លែឈើខ្លះជូនអ៊ំ។
lines.rom: baat, or-kun om. khnhom mean phlae-cheu khlah joon om.
lines.en: Thank you, auntie. I brought some fruit for you.

lines.speaker: B
lines.km: ឱ! មិនបាច់ពិបាកទេ គិតតែអរគុណច្រើនហើយណា។
lines.rom: oh! min-bach pi-baak te, kit tae or-kun chroeun haeuy naa.
lines.en: Oh! You shouldn't have, thank you so much.

lines.speaker: A
lines.km: បាទ មិនអីទេអ៊ំ ខ្ញុំរីករាយណាស់ដែលបានជួបអ៊ំ។
lines.rom: baat, min ey te om, khnhom rik-reay nah dael baan juob om.
lines.en: You're welcome, auntie. I'm very glad to meet you.

lines.speaker: B
lines.km: ចាស អង្គុយលេងសិនទៅ ចាំអ៊ំទៅយកទឹកជូន។
lines.rom: jaa, ang-kuy leing sin tov, jam om tov yok teuk joon.
lines.en: Have a seat first, I'll go get some water for you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.km: អាឡូ អូន! បងប្រហែលជាទៅផ្ទះយឺតបន្តិចហើយ។
lines.rom: A-lo oun! Bong bra-hêl jie tow phteah yeut bon-tich hoey.
lines.en: Hello honey! I might be coming home a bit late.

lines.speaker: B
lines.km: ចាសបង មានការអីមែនទេ?
lines.rom: Chas bong, mien ka ei men te?
lines.en: Yes dear, is something going on?

lines.speaker: A
lines.km: បាទ ស្ទះផ្លូវខ្លាំងណាស់ ហើយការងារមិនទាន់រួចទៀត។
lines.rom: Baht, steah phlow klang nah, hoey ka-ngea min tean ruoch tiet.
lines.en: Yeah, traffic is really bad and my work isn't done yet.

lines.speaker: B
lines.km: មិនអីទេបង! ចាំញ៉ាំបាយជុំគ្នាណា។
lines.rom: Min ei te bong! Cham nyam bay jum knea na.
lines.en: That's fine! I'll wait so we can eat together, okay?

lines.speaker: A
lines.km: បាទ! អរគុណអូន ជួបគ្នាឆាប់ៗនេះ។
lines.rom: Baht! Or-kun oun, juob knea chap-chap nih.
lines.en: Thanks honey! See you soon.

lines.speaker: A
lines.km: សុំទោសបង ផ្សារថ្មីទៅតាមណាដែរ?
lines.rom: Som-tos bong, Psar Thmey tov tam na dae?
lines.en: Excuse me, how do I get to Central Market?

lines.speaker: B
lines.km: ចាស បងជិះត្រង់ទៅ រួចបត់ស្តាំ។
lines.rom: Chas, bong jih trong tov, ruoch bat sdam.
lines.en: Go straight ahead, and then turn right.

lines.speaker: A
lines.km: ដល់ស្តុប ទើបបត់ស្តាំមែនទេបាទ?
lines.rom: Dol stop, teub bat sdam men te baat?
lines.en: At the traffic light, then turn right, correct?

lines.speaker: B
lines.km: ចាសមែនហើយ បន្ទាប់មកបត់ឆ្វេងភ្លាម ដល់ហើយ។
lines.rom: Chas men haeuy, bantoap mok bat chhveng phleam, dol haeuy.
lines.en: Yes, exactly, then immediately turn left and you're there.

lines.speaker: A
lines.km: បាទ អរគុណច្រើនណាស់បង!
lines.rom: Baat, orkun chraen nah bong!
lines.en: Got it, thank you very much!

lines.speaker: B
lines.km: ចាស មិនអីទេបង!
lines.rom: Chas, mun ey te bong!
lines.en: You're welcome!

lines.speaker: A
lines.km: សួស្តីអ្នកមីង! ខ្ញុំឈឺក្បាលខ្លាំងណាស់បាទ។
lines.rom: Suos-dey neak-ming! Knhom cheu kbal klang nas baat.
lines.en: Hello auntie! I have a really bad headache.

lines.speaker: B
lines.km: ចាស៎ក្មួយ! ឈឺយូរប៉ុន្មានថ្ងៃហើយ?
lines.rom: Jaa kmuoy! Cheu yoo bon-maan thngai heuy?
lines.en: Yes nephew! How many days have you had it?

lines.speaker: A
lines.km: ទើបតែឈឺព្រឹកមិញនេះទេបាទ។
lines.rom: Teub tae cheu preuk-minh nih te baat.
lines.en: It just started this morning.

lines.speaker: B
lines.km: អ៊ីចឹងលេបថ្នាំប៉ារ៉ានេះទៅ មួយថ្ងៃបីដង។
lines.rom: Ey-jeung leb thnam para nih tow, muoy thngai bei dorng.
lines.en: Then take this paracetamol, three times a day.

lines.speaker: A
lines.km: បាទ អរគុណច្រើន! មួយបន្ទះប៉ុន្មានដែរ?
lines.rom: Baat, or-kun chraen! Muoy bonteah bon-maan dae?
lines.en: Yes, thank you! How much is one blister pack?

lines.speaker: B
lines.km: មួយបន្ទះតែពីរពាន់រៀលទេក្មួយ។
lines.rom: Muoy bonteah tae pii-poan riel te kmuoy.
lines.en: Just two thousand riel a pack, nephew.
